name: compaction
description: When a session grows past its trim threshold, or sits idle above its prune target while its prompt cache is about to lapse, the oldest part of it is replaced by a summary the agent's own model writes, with the actions already taken listed beside it. Shipped in the binary and attached to every agent; disable it for an agent to fall back to the runtime's plain trim. Reference example for ContextThreshold and CacheExpiring hooks.
